notes.title: One Way Road: Firehunt - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795096/c3a751ea49d6ebb935092bb3bc5a9ab3bfb890eb.gif

I'm super excited to announce the release of the free version of One Way Road on May 29th at 10:00 AM Pacific Daylight Time.
The countdown is on! Only 2 weeks left.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630030/One_Way_Road_Firehunt/

This is only the beginning of the story about Space Fleet Commander, James Dekker.

The main differences from the previously released demo version:

 All game mechanics are available.
 Steam achievements.
 The reward for completing the prologue.

See you aboard the Space cruiser!

Don't forget to wishlist and follow the full game! This helps a lot and I truly appreciate it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599490/One_Way_Road/

Got any questions about the game?
Join the Discord community and don't be shy to ask.
